title: Stateful consultant runtime should be atom/workflow-native instead of Badgey-specific
wanted_capability: A reusable stateful consultant primitive that exposes instance identity, resumable session binding, proposal lifecycle, action journaling, and workflow-visible apply/dispatch through atom contracts and workflow nodes, so Badgey is one configured consumer rather than a bespoke daemon feature.
missing_primitive: Atom/workflow-native consultant runtime with generic instance registry, proposal store, action journal, intent post-processor, and split apply protocol.
fallback_used: Badgey implements these facilities through bespoke badgey_* MCP tools, BadgeyId, BadgeyRegistry, ProposalStore under state_dir/badgey, bg-action-* note parsing, and Badgey-specific workflow MCP calls.
notes: Existing workflow machinery already supports atom_bindings, workflow-backed atoms, hook mcp_call, foreach/subworkflow fanout, gates, actor_failure=continue, and structured workflow handles. Badgey apply/triage workflows show the desired direction, but the core consultant state remains outside atom invocation ownership/effects/composition.
resolution_note: Dissolved over phases 0–4 on the badgey-dissolution branch (design/orchestration/agents/consultant-runtime.md, lifecycle: implemented; thread-a6523755). Generic consultant runtime now owns instance identity/registry (ConsultantId/ConsultantRegistry + resume queues), the proposal store and action journal (vocabulary-agnostic), the ThreadEvent vocabulary, and the descriptor-parameterized turn loop. ConsumerDescriptor is the code-owned configuration boundary (vocabulary, grammar, brofiles, hooks via ConsumerHooks, state layout via legacy_state_subdir); registry: consultant::consumers. Workflow-visible apply/dispatch: consultant_proposals_list / consultant_apply_proposal / consultant_proposal_{begin,complete}_apply MCP tools (badgey_* remain as pinned shims; shipped arcs re-pointed), plus AtomImplementation::Consultant invoke-per-turn atom backend (badgey-consult atom). Badgey is one configured consumer. Docs: docs/consultant-runtime.md.
